entities.name: Abu Bakar ibn Hassan bin Ali
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Bakr ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī was the son of Hasan ibn Ali. He went to Karbala with his uncle Husayn ibn Ali, and was killed in the Battle of Karbala on the day of Ashura.
